view.title: Troops
view.intro: Camp levels, capacity and speed bonuses come from other pages and are read only. Plan works out what training and promotion take. Start training marks a batch that a camp is running.

cards.powerNote: Power per troop comes from the package. Tiers 10 and 11 follow the Fire Crystal level of each camp.

tiers.title: {name} tiers
tiers.hiddenNote: Tier 1 to 9 are hidden. Furnace {furnace} is level 30 or higher.

plan.title: Plan Troops
plan.description: Training and promotion for the three troop types

export.emptyHint: Add a train to export it.
export.promotedReason: Promotion scores only through speedup minutes.
export.powerReason: The package has no real power per tier yet.

plan.noRuns: No trains yet. Add a troop to start a plan.

speed.readOnlyNote: Read only values are carried over from other pages. Change them there.
speed.title: Capacity and speed
speed.appointmentNote: Only one of the two appointments can be on. Minister of Education adds {moeCapacity} capacity and {moeSpeed} percent speed (Supreme {moeCapacitySupreme} and {moeSpeedSupreme}). Vice President adds {vpSpeed} percent speed (Supreme {vpSpeedSupreme}).

stock.name: Training speedups
stock.note: Your stock: Training {training} min, General {general} min. General speedups count toward training. Training that a speedup does not cover finishes in normal time, so only the speedups you hold are used: {used} min.

result.title: Result
result.tier12Note: The package says the Tier 12 costs are partly derived. The Marksman promotion cost was measured in the game, and the Infantry and Lancer costs were scaled from it.

queue.title: Training queues
queue.note: Each camp trains one batch at a time. Finish adds the troops to your counts.
queue.idle: Nothing is training. Start a batch to use this camp.

manage.finishText: Finish upgrade adds the troops to your counts, frees the camp and adds the batch to your History. At zero time left the card says Ready to finish. Nothing finishes by itself, because you may have used speedups.

flyout.title: Start training
flyout.description: Mark a batch as training or promoting in a camp
flyout.campHelp: One batch at a time in each camp. A busy camp says when it frees.
flyout.capacityHint: A batch holds up to {capacity} troops. This is the research capacity plus your camp levels.
flyout.noTiers: This camp has no tier to train yet. Raise the camp level on the Buildings page.
flyout.timeHint: Training speed comes from the Bonuses page. Use Already started when the game shows a different time.

takeCost.title: Take the cost from my stock
takeCost.hint: Takes the resources of the batch from Resources. A count never goes below 0.
takeCost.short: Short on {names}. The stock goes to 0 for those.

flyout.allCampsHint: Starts the same batch in every free camp at once. Each camp keeps its own time. Tiers shown are the ones every free camp can train.

finished.title: {what} trained
finished.message: Added to your troop counts and to History.

cancelled.title: {what} cancelled
cancelled.message: Your troop counts stay as they were. Fix your stock on Resources if needed.

callOfWar.title: Call of War
callOfWar.note: Romulus skill. One free claim for each UTC day, for all camps together. It resets at 00:00 UTC.
callOfWar.claimed: Claimed today. A new claim is free in {time}.
callOfWar.notUnlocked: Needs Romulus recruited and Call of War at level 1 or higher on the Experts page.
